record.question: Which of the following statements are correct? (i) By-Elections:- An election which is held out of normal schedule is called by-election. (ii) Mid-term Elections:- If the Lok Sabha or any of the state assemblies is dissolved before the expiry of its full term and elections are held to constitute a new house, it is called mid-term elections. (iii) General Elections:- A general election is a political voting election where generally all or most members of a given political body are chosen. (iv) Snap Poll:- A snap poll is an election that is called earlier than the one that has been scheduled. It can happen by dissolution of Lok Sabha before its full tenure.
